So `PEEK_S(pc)` reads `(pc)[0]<<8|(pc)[1]` - 2 bytes. The `dispatch` function reads `PEEK_S(s->iseq+pos0)` which reads 2 bytes at `pos0`. If `pos0` is at the last byte of the buffer, this reads 1 byte OOB.
